phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, you have a ground-oriented army with Zerglings and Queens, moderate production, and a heavy economy. The opponent's army is unknown, but they have a heavy economy and moderate expansions.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you gain more information about the opponent's composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion while keeping a modest ground force for safety.
phase_policies.target: Increase your economy and expansions, and continue developing your ground army and technology.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Ground Macro with Heavy Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansions without maintaining a defensive ground presence to scout and respond to early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240-360 seconds, you have a ground-oriented army with Zerglings and Queens, moderate production, and a heavy economy. The opponent may show a ground posture with Zealots and Sentries, or an unknown posture with heavy economy and expansions.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance economy growth with ground army strength, adapting to opponent cues.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army while increasing your economy. Maintain your current expansion and production, and continue technology development.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting for air transitions or heavy pressure while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 420-540 seconds, you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, heavy production and technology. The opponent may show a ground posture with Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prisms, or an air posture with Void Rays and Oracles.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain strong economy and tech while reinforcing ground army, with anti-air readiness.
phase_policies.target: Increase your economy and technology, continue expanding and producing. Strengthen your ground army further.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground-only forces without preparing anti-air if the opponent shows air units.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600-720 seconds, you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, heavy production and technology. The opponent shows a ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue economic and tech growth while reinforcing ground forces.
phase_policies.target: Increase your economy and technology, continue expanding and producing. Strengthen your ground army further.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect economy or upgrades while focusing solely on ground army strength.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
